messages:
maya: Quick sync: finalizing webinar LP + battlecard. Need two hero soundbites, a 1-paragraph bench note, and a minimal lead-routing payload for the form. Goal: hand to SDRs tomorrow AM.
rachel: I'll run a concise bench: hosted vs dedicated for chat (2k) and embeddings (batch 64). p50/p95 + cost per 1k. Short CSV by 2pm.
tom: I'll capture warm vs cold tail and note caching impact. Will keep appendix language tight.
maya: Soundbite drafts: A) 'Production-first inference: control latency, cut unit cost' B) 'One serving API across hosted → dedicated → private' Thoughts?
sam: Prefer less absolute phrasing. Maybe A) 'Reduces unit cost while controlling latency' and call out 'up to' percent in appendix.
rachel: Agreed. I'll label numbers 'up to 45% reduction under common configs' and attach bench.
jordan: For routing: form should emit JSON payload keys: {"webinar_signal":"true","region":"NA|EU|APAC","intent":"hot|warm|cold"} and POST to /hooks/lead-route. Hot -> AE immediate, warm -> SDR sequence, cold -> nurture.
sdrbot: Reminder: update SDR playbook + Marketo mapping before 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: I'll assemble the battlecard (top 3 objections vs cloud endpoints + quick rebut bullets) and drop for review by 4pm. If no edits, ship to field tomorrow. :rocket:
